setup:
Help me set up vibePMS on Railway. I do not have coding experience, so explain each step in plain English and handle the code where your tools allow.

Source: https://github.com/pmsvibe60-creator/vibePMS
First read README.md and deploy/railway/README.md in my fork or local copy. Ask what accounts I have, my market, and my monthly hosting budget. Help me create my own fork if needed.

Guide me through the services, storage, environment settings, Twenty workspace, email and CasaPay sandbox configuration. Show costs and get my approval before provisioning paid services. Have me enter secrets directly in service settings, never public code or issues.

Use fictional data to test health, signing, invoices, payment events and data persistence. Tell me what actually passed and what remains unverified; do not assume the Railway template is validated.

If you find a reproducible vibePMS bug, check existing GitHub Issues and report it at https://github.com/pmsvibe60-creator/vibePMS/issues with steps, expected/actual results, versions and sanitized logs. If you cannot submit, give me the report to paste. Report security vulnerabilities privately.
customize:
Help me customize my vibePMS installation. I do not have coding experience. Read README.md and inspect the code before making changes.

Ask me what I want to change: branding, language, contract templates, invoices or a rental workflow. Explain the options in plain English, then implement the smallest useful change in my fork. Adapt assumptions to my market rather than claiming universal compliance.

Use fictional data, run the relevant tests and show me how to review the result before deploying. Keep credentials and tenant records out of source control.

If you discover a reproducible upstream bug, check https://github.com/pmsvibe60-creator/vibePMS/issues for duplicates and report it with reproduction steps, expected/actual results, versions and sanitized logs. If submission is unavailable, prepare the report for me. Use private reporting for security vulnerabilities.
debug:
Help me troubleshoot vibePMS. I do not have coding experience. Read README.md and deploy/railway/README.md, then ask what I was trying to do, what happened, my installed version, and which service failed.

Guide me to the relevant logs and explain how to remove secrets and personal data before sharing them. Diagnose whether this is configuration, an external service problem, or a bug in vibePMS. Preserve existing data and propose the smallest safe fix.

For a reproducible vibePMS bug, search https://github.com/pmsvibe60-creator/vibePMS/issues for an existing report. If none exists, open an issue with a clear title, reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior, versions and sanitized logs. If you cannot post, provide a ready-to-paste report and the issue link. Do not publish credentials, tenant data or security vulnerabilities; use the repository's private security reporting channel for vulnerabilities.

Verify the fix and tell me what remains uncertain.
